summary: Remote-controlled shell over WebSocket enables full-host RCE
details: The agent opens a persistent WebSocket connection to a configurable server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via SERVER_URL/--server to point at a remote control server) and dispatches incoming messages to handlers that spawn a system PTY shell and pipe network-received bytes directly into that shell's stdin. handleTerminalCreate spawns pty.spawn(process.env.SHELL||'bash',...) and handleTerminalInput writes msg.data from socket.on('message',...) into term.pty.write. Additional server-issued verbs route through message-router.js to perform arbitrary file read/write/delete/move, git push, MCP config mutation, and package self-upgrade (handleUpgradeAgent runs `npm view @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest version` then generates upgrade.sh/upgrade.bat that runs `npm install...@<latest>` and restarts the process via systemd/launchd/PM2). Whichever party controls the configured WebSocket server obtains interactive shell access and arbitrary file/code control on the host running the agent, plus the ability to swap the running package for a newer publisher-controlled version on demand.
